candidates.name: M8 streaming music on Android
candidates.saving: 24-34 MiB PSS in a match, 40-94 MiB at the peak (music on)
candidates.complexity: medium (packet decode on demand; identical samples)
candidates.risk: decode moves onto the music stream's callback: audio thread time to measure with music on

candidates.name: Uniform pages shared (replay recording)
candidates.risk: one copy-on-write page per written page

candidates.name: Mixer PCM through the wave storage records
Journal copies (M7b and the session levels)
candidates.complexity: high: every commit walks the journal

ramAudit.decision: Continue: a justified reserve of ~55-90 MiB at reasonable complexity (music, uniform pages, mixer PCM); one mechanism per gate, music first.
